author: Madison Conner
title: Video shows fatal ambush unfold near Frontier Restaurant - NewsBreak
text:
By Madison Conner ,
5 hours ago
ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. (KRQE) – Surveillance video showed just how quickly a planned attack left a man with deadly wounds outside a restaurant near the University of New Mexico.
Story continues below
A quiet parking lot just behind Frontier Restaurant on Central Ave. quickly turned into a crime scene two weeks ago. The Albuquerque Police Department said that the four men seen on surveillance video waiting in a vehicle nearby are Tenard Weekly, Junior Lewis, Evan Rogers, and Jaylen Hopewell.
The four suspects crept behind a dumpster, waiting. That’s when the victim, 23-year-old Eden Rock, and a fifth suspect, 20-year-old Zakiya Umstead, walked into the camera’s view. Once in sight, video showed the four suspects running toward Rock and attacking him. Umstead turned and at first walked away, but when a gunshot went off, she took off running. The four men also took off back to their car. Rock died from his injuries at the hospital.
Detectives believe the attack was planned and that Rock has been lured outside by Umstead inside the restaurant. Police said Rock and Weekly, the man suspected of pulling the trigger, had been in a feud earlier that day.
Weekly, Rogers, Lewis, and Hopewell are all being held awaiting trial. Umstead was arrested in Houston last week. She’s facing charges for murder, conspiracy, and tampering with evidence.
